epics.title: Product Containerization and Local Environment
epics.jtbd: When I want to run the product locally, I want to start the full stack with one command, so that I can observe and verify its actual behavior.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local deployment time to under 5 minutes
requirements: R1: Add docker-compose.yml to start the full stack.

slices.title: Add docker-compose and health-check endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing the local environment for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose configuration and health check, so that the full stack can be launched and verified locally
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a cloned repository, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully
Given the stack is running, When I access the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a healthy status
Given a clean environment, When the stack is launched end-to-end, Then all services are healthy and responsive in integration tests

requirements: R1: Add UI support for updating an existing material via PUT endpoint.
R2: Add UI support for deleting an existing material via DELETE endpoint.

slices.title: Patch frontend UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the material update and delete UI for this epic, I want to patch the existing views, so that the catalog can be accurately maintained
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When the user submits an update, Then a PUT request is sent and the material updates
Given an existing material, When the user confirms deletion, Then a DELETE request is sent and the material is removed
Given these actions, When tested end-to-end and with integration tests, Then the UI updates and deletes materials correctly
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual database updates for materials to 0

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog or creating materials.
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in when attempting access.

slices.title: Patch existing code to implement authentication and session mechanism
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to enforce access control on the catalog, so that unauthorized access is blocked and users are prompted to log in
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access restricted resources, Then access is denied
Given an unauthenticated user, When access is denied, Then they are prompted to log in
Given these changes, When tested with integration and E2E tests, Then access control functions correctly and unauthorized access is reliably blocked
